env.installPhase:
runHook preInstall
modules="$out/lib/node_modules"
mkdir -p "$modules" "$tarball"
cp /nix/store/4bbk51vd1qbw0mhc1zimnnrlcfwcp0dz-npm-project-release/commander.tgz "$tarball/package.tgz"
if [ -d /nix/store/z642qzqd9iah5wpvvk23zwxlyb2n5xwr-npm-project-production-modules/node_modules ]; then
  cp -a /nix/store/z642qzqd9iah5wpvvk23zwxlyb2n5xwr-npm-project-production-modules/node_modules/. "$modules/"
  chmod -R u+w "$modules"
  rm -rf "$modules/.bin" "$modules/.package-lock.json"
fi
rm -rf "$modules"/commander
mkdir -p "$modules"/commander
tar -xzf /nix/store/4bbk51vd1qbw0mhc1zimnnrlcfwcp0dz-npm-project-release/commander.tgz --strip-components=1 \
  -C "$modules"/commander


chmod -R u+w "$modules"


runHook postInstall
env.name: commander-15.0.0

env.buildCommand:
export HOME="$TMPDIR/home"
mkdir -p "$HOME"
cp -R /nix/store/3848qxc8in37qd37ljxv578q8varsfrq-source project
chmod -R u+w project
cd project
patchShebangs .
cp package-lock.json "$TMPDIR/original-lock.json"
cp package.json "$TMPDIR/original-manifest.json"
export npm_config_registry=http://127.0.0.1:9/
export npm_config_offline=true
export npm_config_audit=false
export npm_config_fund=false
export npm_config_cache="$TMPDIR/cold-cache"
if npm ci > "$TMPDIR/cold.log" 2>&1; then
  echo "ordinary npm unexpectedly installed with an empty offline cache" >&2
  exit 1
fi
grep ENOTCACHED "$TMPDIR/cold.log"
mkdir -p "$TMPDIR/prepared-cache/_cacache"
cp -rs --no-preserve=mode /nix/store/21z04nsanxlajpasxsa2qc6z94azcq1s-npm-purifier-interactive/cache/. "$TMPDIR/prepared-cache/_cacache"
export npm_config_cache="$TMPDIR/prepared-cache"
npm ci
patchShebangs node_modules
npm test
cmp package-lock.json "$TMPDIR/original-lock.json"
cmp package.json "$TMPDIR/original-manifest.json"
mkdir -p "$out"
node --version > "$out/node-version"
npm --version > "$out/npm-version"
echo aarch64-darwin > "$out/system"
env.name: commander-native-offline

env.buildCommand:
export HOME="$TMPDIR/home" GRADLE_USER_HOME="$TMPDIR/gradle"
mkdir -p "$HOME"
python /nix/store/z9xvbxdcm0r9ga5b7q4z706l9s130fim-darwin-loopback.py
# Darwin's sandbox denies the JDK's IPv4-mapped IPv6 loopback path.
# Keep this adaptation within the ordinary WebJar consumer test.
export JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS="${JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS:+$JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS }-Djava.net.preferIPv4Stack=true"
/nix/store/xr0h7rmm6a91nnsrsyp9xa5wnsb9qh70-zulu-ca-jdk-21.0.11/bin/java -XshowSettings:properties -version > java-properties.log 2>&1
cat java-properties.log
grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*java.net.preferIPv4Stack = true$' java-properties.log

python - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, zipfile
catalog = json.load(open('/nix/store/q9xyv6w438jsy2jxvi6vcl8gwamrnxnr-webjar-projection-metadata/catalog.json'))
module, = catalog['modules']
open('coordinate', 'w').write(f"{module['group']}:{module['name']}:{module['version']}")
jar, = pathlib.Path('/nix/store/b695mr4fvrh1z6hrkjbd4xpwrzzs64j1-webjar-projection').rglob('*.jar')
with zipfile.ZipFile(jar) as archive:
    names = archive.namelist()
    assert not any('node_modules' in name or '.env' in name or 'build.js' in name for name in names)
    assert b'42' in archive.read('META-INF/resources/webjars/proof__browser/1.0.0/proof.js')
PY
cat > settings.gradle <<'GRADLE'
rootProject.name = 'ordinary-webjar-consumer'
GRADLE
cat > build.gradle <<'GRADLE'
repositories { maven { url = uri('/nix/store/b695mr4fvrh1z6hrkjbd4xpwrzzs64j1-webjar-projection') } }
configurations { assets }
dependencies { assets file('coordinate').text }
tasks.register('verify') {
  doLast {
    assert System.getProperty('java.net.preferIPv4Stack') == 'true'
def jar = new java.util.jar.JarFile(configurations.assets.singleFile)
    def resource = jar.getJarEntry('META-INF/resources/webjars/proof__browser/1.0.0/proof.js')
    assert jar.getInputStream(resource).text.contains('42')
    jar.close()
  }
}
GRADLE
command -v gradle
gradle --version
gradleStatus=0
gradle --offline --no-daemon --stacktrace verify > gradle-console.log 2>&1 || gradleStatus=$?
cat gradle-console.log || true
if [ "$gradleStatus" -ne 0 ]; then
  python /nix/store/1ybzsr5vw1kxkqq0vi8j09n0lhgifdn6-gradle-diagnostics.py --gradle-home "$GRADLE_USER_HOME" \
    --project "$PWD" --tmpdir "$TMPDIR" || true
  exit "$gradleStatus"
fi
test -n "$(find /nix/store/ah7h8d2yv8k3g5nm2s6r52za07r21r55-jvm-projection-ivy -name '*.jar')"
touch $out
env.name: npm-webjar-ordinary-consumers
